challenge.better_approach: Considered the full sweep on the beat (2.1-3.2 s per beat measured under 2f0a6ea8c966, superseded) and a second writer in the at-rest probe. The orchestrator ruled both out: the cost here is bounded by the standing troubles, measured 33 s for the six live ones against 5m25s for the sweep.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That every sieve can run alone, outside the shake. Measured: the nest has one phase (43 sieves, phase 1), so no sieve reads another's output.
challenge.prior_art: Ticket 044020db63c0 made only the whole-repo run reconcile; this reuses its rule (_standing_finding_ids, above baseline) so the two clear paths agree. 874d6b660d9d (post-build-inspector) has no cursor and sets no cadence.
challenge.real_collision: None. The prefix reconcile in the whole-repo run is unchanged; this sends exact-identity clears, which the trouble device's drain decides on (Law 6).

answers.falsifier: In a scratch world, a recheck of two finding troubles clears only the one whose cause is gone; it runs only the named sieves; cairn cleanup passes the standing ids to it before the drain.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator measured it and gave the shape: a finding trouble whose cause a voyage fixed stands until a hand sweeps, since bin/cmd/cleanup only drains
answers.how: The inspector in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py gains recheck(identities) and --recheck: only the named sieves, over every component, then clear_trouble by exact identity for each sieve with nothing above baseline. bin/cmd/cleanup gains a findings step before the drain that reads cairn trouble live --json and passes the inspector-new-finding-* ids. Red-first proofs: a scratch world with one cleared cause and one standing cause, and a scratch copy of cleanup beside a stub cairn.
answers.traces_to: Law 7: a trouble is a record of truth about a cause, and one that stands after its cause is gone says something false. Law 1: a voyage that fixed the cause should not leave the clearing to a hand re-deriving it with a five-minute sweep.
answers.what: cairn cleanup re-runs the sieve behind each standing finding trouble over the whole repo and clears the troubles whose sieve no longer fires.

bullets.text: cairn cleanup now rechecks each standing finding trouble's sieve over the whole repo, so a fix that lands at a voyage's end clears its trouble without a hand sweep. Measured 33 s for the six live troubles.
